news.headline: Where Could Zscaler's Next Growth Come From?
news.summary: Zscaler's best candidate for upside is a product line that its fiscal 2027 outlook does not call out. The stock has risen 46% over the past three months. It is still 43% below its 52-week high. The outlook matters now because it has revenue growth slowing. It calls for growth of 16.6% to 17.5%, from 25% in fiscal 2026. So which Zscaler (ZS) business could add growth beyond that outlook.
